description: This file defines middleware functions for handling source maps and stack frames in a React development overlay, including source map retrieval, original source position mapping, and editor launching.

classes.name: OverlayMiddlewareOptions
classes.description: Options for configuring the overlay middleware, including Webpack version and functions to get stats.

classes.name: OriginalStackFrameResponse
classes.description: Response containing the original stack frame and code frame for a source-mapped position.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: Type representing a source with a method to get its source map.

methods.name: getModuleId
methods.description: Retrieves the module ID from a compilation, handling Webpack 5 and earlier versions.

methods.name: getModuleSource
methods.description: Gets the source code of a module, handling Webpack 5 and earlier versions.

methods.name: getSourcePath
methods.description: Normalizes source paths by removing Webpack-specific prefixes.

methods.name: findOriginalSourcePositionAndContent
methods.description: Finds the original source position and content from a source map given a line and column.

methods.name: createOriginalStackFrame
methods.description: Creates a stack frame with original source information based on source maps.

methods.name: getOverlayMiddleware
methods.description: Main function that returns middleware handling source map requests and editor launching.
